name: Gujarat Forensic Sciences University
evidence: The official NFSU About page identifies National Forensic Sciences University as the erstwhile Gujarat Forensic Sciences University and states that the Government of India accorded it status as a central university in October 2020.
notes: The supplied legacy domain produced a self-signed certificate-in-chain error and then a 502 response; curl --insecure was used only for public GET requests as permitted.
The official successor domain confirms the named institution identity and legal status.
